item.title: eBay To Acquire Depop From Etsy For $1.2 Billion In Cash
item.description: eBay and Etsy announced they have entered into a definitive agreement under which eBay will acquire Depop, a consumer-to-consumer fashion marketplace focused on secondhand apparel, for approximately $1.2 billion in cash, subject to certain purchase price adjustments.
